items.name: AmCharts
items.description: JavaScript charting and data visualization library used to create interactive charts, graphs, and maps for web applications.

items.name: Angular
items.description: TypeScript-based web application framework maintained by Google for building single-page applications with a component-based architecture.

items.name: AngularJS
items.description: Original JavaScript-based front-end framework from Google for building dynamic single-page web applications, predecessor to the rewritten Angular framework.

items.name: Aurelia
items.description: JavaScript front-end framework for building single-page applications and web components with an emphasis on standards-based, convention-driven development.

items.name: Axios
items.description: Promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript used in browsers and Node.js to make requests to APIs and handle responses.

items.name: Babel
items.description: JavaScript compiler that converts modern ECMAScript syntax into backward-compatible versions so code runs on older browsers and environments.

items.name: Blazor
items.description: Web framework from Microsoft that lets developers build interactive web UIs using C# and .NET instead of JavaScript, running on the server or in the browser via WebAssembly.

items.name: Bootstrap
items.description: Front-end CSS framework that provides pre-built components and a responsive grid system for quickly designing web page layouts.

items.name: D3.js
items.description: JavaScript library for producing dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers by binding data to DOM elements and SVG.

items.name: Docusaurus
items.description: Static site generator built with React designed for creating documentation websites, with support for versioning and Markdown content.

items.name: Electron
items.description: Framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, combining Chromium and Node.js.

items.name: jQuery
items.description: JavaScript library that simplifies DOM manipulation, event handling, and AJAX requests, historically widely used to write cross-browser compatible scripts.

items.name: Kendo UI
items.description: Commercial UI component library providing widgets and controls for building web applications, with versions for various JavaScript frameworks.

items.name: Knockout.js
items.description: JavaScript library that implements the Model-View-ViewModel pattern, enabling automatic UI updates through observable data binding.

items.name: Moment.js
items.description: JavaScript library for parsing, validating, manipulating, and formatting dates and times. Widely used in older web projects, though now in maintenance mode with lighter alternatives recommended for new code.

items.name: Next.js
items.description: React framework that adds server-side rendering, static site generation, routing, and API routes on top of React. Used to build production-ready web applications with improved performance and SEO.

items.name: NgRx
items.description: State management library for Angular applications based on reactive programming and the Redux pattern, using RxJS observables to manage application state and side effects in a predictable way.

items.name: PrimeNG
items.description: UI component library for Angular providing a large collection of ready-made widgets like tables, charts, and forms to speed up building application interfaces.

items.name: React
items.description: JavaScript library for building user interfaces using a component-based architecture. Widely used for single-page applications and as the foundation for many other frontend frameworks.

items.name: Recharts
items.description: Charting library for React built on top of D3, providing composable components for creating common chart types like line, bar, and pie charts.

items.name: Redux
items.description: Predictable state container for JavaScript applications, commonly used with React, that centralizes application state and enforces unidirectional data flow through actions and reducers.

items.name: Remix
items.description: Full-stack web framework built on React that focuses on server-side rendering, nested routing, and data loading, aiming to improve performance and user experience for web applications.

items.name: RxJS
items.description: Library for reactive programming in JavaScript using observables, enabling composition of asynchronous and event-based programs through operators like map, filter, and merge.

items.name: Tailwind CSS
items.description: Utility-first CSS framework that provides low-level classes for styling elements directly in markup, allowing developers to build custom designs without writing separate CSS files.

items.name: Telerik
items.description: Suite of UI component libraries and developer tools from Progress Software for building web, desktop, and mobile applications across platforms like .NET, React, and Angular.

items.name: Three.js
items.description: JavaScript library that simplifies creating and rendering 3D graphics in web browsers using WebGL, commonly used for visualizations, games, and interactive experiences.

items.name: TinyMCE
items.description: Web-based rich text editor that can be embedded into applications to provide WYSIWYG content editing capabilities, similar to a word processor, within a browser.

items.name: Vite
items.description: Frontend build tool and development server that provides fast hot module replacement and optimized bundling, commonly used with frameworks like Vue and React.

items.name: Vue.js
items.description: Progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces and single-page applications, known for its approachable learning curve and component-based architecture.

items.name: Windows Forms
items.description: UI framework in .NET for building desktop applications on Windows using a drag-and-drop designer and event-driven programming model.

items.name: Windows Presentation Foundation
items.description: UI framework in .NET for building desktop applications on Windows, using XAML for declarative interface design and supporting rich graphics, data binding, and styling.
